title: App Verification
description: App verification data for PUT operations that replace the entire app verifications array

createdAt.description: The date the record was created

createdBy.description: The user who created the record

updatedAt.description: The date the record was last updated

updatedBy.description: The user who last updated the record

attachments.description: Array of attachment metadata for this record

verifiedDate.description: Date when this record was verified

disclosureQuestions.description: Array of disclosure questions (only populated for Disclosure Questions verification type)

favorableAnswerCounts.description: Count of favorable disclosure answers (only for Disclosure Questions verification type)

unfavorableAnswerCounts.description: Count of unfavorable disclosure answers (only for Disclosure Questions verification type)

deceasedCheckDetails.description: DMF check details for pop-up (only for Deceased Check verification type)

formType.description: The category of form this verification is for; `state` carries which state's form. application: the CAQH application (ProviderHub label: Application). application_release: the CAQH standard authorization/attestation/release page (Application Release). state_release: a state release form (State Release). state_authorization: a state authorization form (State Authorization). disclosure: a state disclosure form, e.g. OR, WA (Disclosure). attestation: a state attestation-question form, e.g. OK Section 13, MS Section D (Section D - Attestation Questions). claims_history: a professional-liability claims information form, e.g. GA Schedule B (Schedule-B Professional Liability Claims Information Form for Georgia State). acknowledgement: a regulation acknowledgement form, e.g. GA Schedule C (Schedule C - Regulation Acknowledgement).

state.description: The 2-letter state this form is for

signaturePresent.description: Whether the form shows a signature

signatureType.description: wet (ink/scanned handwritten), electronic, or unknown when the signature's kind could not be determined

signatureDate.description: The date the form was signed

attestationDate.description: The date of the form's own attestation

clientReference.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. When a create request for this section carries a clientReference equal to an existing record's, the create is deduped and the existing record is returned instead of appending a duplicate.

CredentialingWorkflowAttachment.description: Attachment metadata for credentialing workflow row

fileUrl.description: GCS file URL for file retrieval

artifactLinkId.description: Shared identifier linking this attachment to its corresponding supportingDocuments entry

DeceasedCheckDetails.description: DMF check details for Deceased Check app verification pop-up

isDeceased.description: Whether the person was found in DMF as deceased

verifiedOrProofCode.description: Verified or proof code from DMF

createdAt.description: When the DMF check was recorded

updatedAt.description: When the DMF check record was last updated

DisclosureQuestionItem.description: Individual disclosure question with answer details

answerFlag.description: Flag indicating if the answer is unfavorable (true) or favorable (false)
